propositions: Gates must force measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege posture, instrument type) into the attested-evidence record as structured text fields to enable repo-grounded contradiction detection
A deterministic check must flag [operator-attested] criteria lacking required measurement-provenance fields, with no LLM involvement, surfaced as an advisory criterion per ADR-0054

World-observable evidence (live cloud calls, simulator outputs) remains invisible to gates when privilege masking or instrument type prevents the measurement from failing for the reason being ruled out

An extended attested-evidence contract must capture instrument kind (live-call, simulation, static-analysis) because simulators and live calls are not interchangeable evidence for authorization claims despite both being production-equivalent on their surface

Plans asserting unchanged behaviour across substrate/route/provider swaps without citing the resolution path files that consume that configuration risk escapes because cited files determine what reviewers read
Completion-verifier must not re-run world measurements to validate provenance, as its own credentials carry the same privilege-masking problem that would undermine the validation
